report.requirement: The controller's identity and how to contact it about personal data

report.requirement: Contact details of the data protection officer (DPO)
report.condition: The controller has appointed a DPO
report.evidence: Questions regarding this policy should be directed to Keeta by emailing legal@keeta.com
report.reason: The policy provides contact details for inquiries.

report.requirement: The personal data that is collected
report.evidence: we may collect several types of information from and about users of our Website

report.requirement: The means used to collect personal data
report.evidence: We collect this information: Directly from you when you provide it to us
report.reason: The policy describes the means used to collect personal data.

report.requirement: The purpose of collecting and processing personal data
report.evidence: We identify the purposes for which we use your Personal Information at the time we collect such information
report.reason: The policy clearly states the purposes of collecting personal data.

report.requirement: The legal basis for collecting personal data (e.g. consent, contract, legal obligation)
report.evidence: you accept the terms of this Policy and consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information
report.reason: The policy explicitly states that user consent is required for data collection.

report.requirement: Which personal data is mandatory and which is optional
report.evidence: We may collect several types of information from and about users of our Website
report.reason: The policy mentions types of information but does not clearly distinguish between mandatory and optional data.

report.requirement: The consequences of not providing personal data
report.reason: The policy does not mention any consequences of not providing personal data.

report.requirement: The parties personal data is disclosed or shared with, and their capacity
report.evidence: We may share information about you with third parties on a need-to-know basis
report.reason: The policy clearly states that personal data may be shared with third parties.

report.requirement: Whether personal data is transferred, disclosed or processed outside the Kingdom
report.evidence: we may store and process all or part of your personal and transactional information, in the United States and elsewhere in the world
report.reason: The policy mentions data processing outside the Kingdom but lacks specifics on the extent or nature of such transfers.

report.requirement: How long personal data is kept, or the criteria used to decide
report.evidence: Keeta will retain your personal information for a minimum of five years or as necessary to comply with our legal obligations or to resolve disputes
report.reason: The policy specifies the duration for which personal data is retained.

report.requirement: How personal data is stored and destroyed
report.evidence: We take reasonable administrative, technical, and physical measures to safeguard your personal information
report.reason: The policy mentions security measures but does not detail destruction methods.

report.requirement: The data subject's rights: to be informed, access, obtain a copy, correct, and request destruction
report.evidence: You are entitled to review, correct, or amend your personally identifiable information
report.reason: The policy mentions some rights but does not cover all specified rights.

report.requirement: How the data subject can exercise their rights
report.reason: The policy does not explain how data subjects can exercise their rights.

report.reason: The policy clearly states the measures taken to protect personal data.
